status: Root accepts parallel computational direction with corrections; joint final ticket details and grants remain pending

decisions.change: Claim-relative prerequisites replace the ambiguous blanket DIAG01-05 dependency. Reference recovery, raw evidence, resource profiling and numerical diagnostics may be authored in parallel. TTC and full five-arm work remain open, not prerequisites to the narrow computational comparison.

Ascend is a reconstruction of a published simulation of a commercial package; CPU-DRAM is a human-authored research design. Exact layouts, metrics, solver and source rights must be bound. No measured-silicon, exact-CAD or generalization claim.

Source independently corroborates the internal half-rz_hs path including convection. Derive expected network and test controlled old/new equations with other inputs fixed. A matching fitted paper temperature alone cannot establish cause or physical validation.

Strict common wire-proxy ceiling is distinct from optional 5-percent-relaxed or Pareto tracks. HBM1mm,95C and0.5C need source support or explicit prospective assumptions. Approximate reconstruction stays labeled; sampled perturbation envelopes are not uniform bounds.

Mean cost times1.25 or1.5 is a forecast. Bind intended host/grid/lifecycle, reserve/stop/settlement, exact call manifest and prospective grant. Forge56653's about22solves/under1CPUminute is a request, not measured feasibility or authorization.

Keep v3 INCONCLUSIVE, charges and missing witnesses. New reproduction has a new run identity. The269counter is proposed no-ops before admission, not proof of269native launches. No historical refunds, free opportunities or cached substitutes for fresh required reproductions.

New descriptive development comparisons may proceed after their own adequate numerical/reference and model/provider/payer gates. They do not wait on or replace the full SLAB041 five-arm freeze. Original32opportunity/family/missingness/Holm rules remain for that study.

TAP's zero thermal weight below85C prevents an optimum inference from the near-match. CPU-DRAM's published21.05C reduction accompanies3.19times routed wire; it does not guarantee fixed-wire cheap-versus-reference headroom.
